name: ITsGOLU Extractor
description: A Telegram bot for extracting course content from various educational apps/APIs (AppX, Classplus, Careerwill, etc).

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID, from my.telegram.org.

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API Hash, from my.telegram.org.

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram numeric user ID (get from @userinfobot). The bot's admin.

SUDO_USERS.description: Space-separated list of additional admin user IDs. Defaults to just OWNER_ID if left empty.

CHANNEL_ID.description: Log channel ID (bot must be admin there).

CHANNEL_ID2.description: Force-subscribe channel ID (bot must be admin there).

MONGO_URL.description: Your MongoDB connection string (e.g. from MongoDB Atlas free tier).

PREMIUM_LOGS.description: Channel/chat ID used for premium-related logs.
